name: Davie
dining_districts: the university district around Nova Southeastern and Broward College
the Tower Shops and University Drive corridor
intro: Davie is Broward's college town with a cowboy streak — a university district feeding tens of thousands of students around Nova Southeastern, plus a downtown that keeps its western character with barbecue joints, ranch-style steakhouses, and family restaurants. The University Drive corridor fills in the rest: plazas of independent kitchens, breakfast spots, and caterers serving the town's event barns and rodeo arena.

Campus dining runs on schedule and scale: consistent case volumes, term-calendar swings, and documentation — the same institutional produce program we run for schools across the county. The independents get the other half of our model: split cases, no minimums, and a thirty-minute route from Pompano Beach that puts product in the walk-in before morning prep.
route_note: About 30 minutes southwest of our Pompano Beach warehouse — university-area and downtown stops share the central Broward morning run.

faqs_unique.q: Can you supply campus and university dining in Davie?
faqs_unique.a: Yes. We run institutional accounts with consistent case sizes, scheduled windows, and volumes that follow the academic calendar — plus documentation where food-service programs require it.

faqs_unique.q: Do you deliver to caterers and event kitchens in Davie?
faqs_unique.a: Yes. Caterers can hold a standing baseline and layer event volume on top by the midnight cutoff — useful for rodeo weekends and festival season.
